version_note: Template editorial. Exact text and media as they will be sent. Any change here changes the content hash and needs a fresh owner approval.
altText: Cover slide with a photo (a man in a black jacket in a gym); Swahili: Mpango wa mazoezi unaoishi kwenye simu ya mteja.; English: A training plan that lives on your client’s phone.
JENGA · BUILD slide; Swahili: Jenga mpango kwa dakika, si kwa karatasi.; English: Build a plan from the exercise library or write your own. No more WhatsApp photos of a notebook.
TUMA · SEND slide; Swahili: Mteja anakubali kwanza.; English: Send it; the client accepts it before it starts. Nothing lands on them unannounced.
BADILISHA · EDIT slide; Swahili: Ukibadilisha, anajulishwa.; English: Edit a sent plan and the client is notified. One version, always current.
FUATILIA · FOLLOW slide; Swahili: Unaona maendeleo bila kuuliza.; English: See the workouts they logged in their activity summary. Ask less, coach more.

Checklist slide; Swahili: Trainer kwenye FitFlex anapata hivi.; English: What a trainer gets on FitFlex.; Rows: Profile (who you help, photos, specialties), Booking na malipo (bookings and payment in one app), Ujumbe ndani ya app (in-app messaging with clients), Mipango ya mazoezi (training plans your clients accept)
Call to action; Swahili: Wewe ni trainer? Andika; English: Are you a trainer? Comment; Keyword TRAINER. Tutakutumia DM jinsi ya kujiunga. We’ll DM you how to join.

instagram.text:
Mpango wa mazoezi unaoishi kwenye simu ya mteja. Jenga kutoka kwenye maktaba ya mazoezi, mteja anakubali kwanza, ukibadilisha anajulishwa, na unaona mazoezi aliyorekodi.
Wewe ni trainer? Andika TRAINER.

A training plan that lives on your client’s phone. Build it from the exercise library, the client accepts it first, edits notify them, and you see the workouts they logged. Trainers, comment TRAINER.

#personaltrainer #fitnesscoach #daressalaam #tanzania #fitflexafrica
